title.en: Workbook Practice: Madam Rides the Bus
Journeys, phrasal verbs, and travel dialogue

text.en: Travel opens our eyes to new landscapes. Unit 7 of Words and Expressions 2 pairs a senior couple's cycling adventure in Uttarakhand and a poem on cycling downhill with phrasal verbs and travel writing.

Unit 7 celebrates the joy of travel through 'Pedalling through the Golden Years' (a couple in their sixties cycling across Uttarakhand) and a poem comparing downhill cycling to a bird's flight.
Another passage introduces Mizoram ('land of the hill-dwellers': 'Mi' = people, 'Zo' = hill, 'Ram' = land) and its vibrant folk culture.
Grammar practises building Phrasal Verbs by combining verbs (break, drive, get, fill, wake, turn) with particles (out, down, off, on, in, up).
Editing practises adding capitals, commas, and full stops to an unpunctuated passage about the Sundarbans mangrove delta.
Speaking and Writing focus on polite requests, dialogue completion (recreating Valli's bus conversation), and writing travel advice.
Project work highlights bicycle safety essentials: helmet, hand pump, puncture kit, ORS, and first-aid.
Unit 7 connects Valli's bus ride with cycling adventures in Uttarakhand and the hills of Mizoram.
In 'Pedalling through the Golden Years', Vishav Driman and Kamal Jeet prove age is no barrier to adventure.
Phrasal verbs pair common verbs with particles: 'get on' the bus, 'wake up' early, 'break down' on the road.
Editing the Sundarbans passage requires capitalising proper nouns like Ganga, Brahmaputra, and Sundarbans.
For safe cycling, always carry a helmet, puncture kit, water, and ORS.

problem.en: Form a phrasal verb using 'get' + particle for boarding a bus, and 'break' + particle for a vehicle stopping.

why.en: Valli said, 'I am the one to get on.'

text.en: Vehicle stopping due to fault: 'break down'.

why.en: 'down' combines with 'break' to mean mechanical failure.

prompt.en: Explain how phrasal verbs are formed in Unit 7 and what 'Mizoram' means.

requiredIdeas.en: Phrasal verbs combine a base verb with a particle (up, on, off, down, in, out)
Mizoram means 'land of the hill-dwellers' (Mi + Zo + Ram)
Proper nouns like Sundarbans and Ganga need capital letters

points.en: Unit 7 features cycling in Uttarakhand, a cycling poem, and passages on Sundarbans and Mizoram.
Phrasal verbs pair verbs like get, wake, turn, and break with particles.
Editing checks capitalisation of geographical names and sentence boundaries.
Safe travel includes helmets, tickets, and emergency kits like ORS and puncture repair.
